text: Hii and mazal tov!! I sadly admit I know nothing specific that can help you in your situation, but I always err on the side of caution...put off the trip,  focus on getting through the Ministry. I know there's a great desire to introduce the newest member of the family...but imagine things start getting complicated...do you really need that headache?? Unless Gd forbid someone is in bad shape and there is real urgency in seeing them asap... I'd wait a while...best of luck!
